name: lsp-clangd
description: Language support through clangd. Install the server on the workspace machine, then enable this plugin.

command.description: clangd executable on the workspace machine

compileCommandsDir.description: Directory containing compile_commands.json. Leave empty for clangd to find it.

headerInsertion.description: Let clangd insert the owning header when accepting a completion (iwyu), or disable insertion (never).
